assumptions: Benefits, costs, right tail, downside, reversibility, decay, regret and timing curves are ordinal author judgements on a 0-4 scale, labelled JUDGEMENT, with whether each is a category prior or an action-specific estimate.

How common an activity is (share of U.S. adults doing it on an average day, minutes when done) comes from American Time Use Survey 2014-2016 microdata, recomputed with the survey weights by derive_atus.py from the CRAN atus mirror (OBSERVED). The crosswalk from each action to an ATUS group is judgement; category-level links describe the broader group, and the page says so. It is U.S. data, not Singapore.

Experienced affect comes from Kahneman et al. (2004) Table 1 (909 employed women in Texas), and 31 actions link to published experiments with abstract-level findings (EMPIRICAL). These are this folder's copies of visuals/everyday-actions' data.

O*NET, OECD and Singapore time-use data could not be retrieved from the build environment and are listed without links. ATUS activity-code labels were written from the lexicon's structure because bls.gov was unreachable; the sports codes were checked against their observed durations.

The ontology has 1,374 canonical actions and 26 actions to avoid; contextual instances (action x at most one manner x timing) are not counted as distinct actions, so the 10,000-canonical-action target is not met.

Extreme-downside probabilities are word labels (very low, low, unknown, moderate), never numbers. Unknown is shown as unknown, not as safe. The repeated-exposure chart uses a per-exposure probability you choose, clearly marked as hypothetical.

Singapore context (daylight about 07:00-19:15, midday heat 11:00-16:00, typical opening hours, lightning) is a separate adjustment on top of the global prior and can be switched off. Live weather is not known; outdoor actions say so.

Class scores, time fit and lens rankings are MODEL transforms of the facts and inherit their confidence. Decision history is stored only in this browser, shown with its sample size and never used to change rankings.
